SELECT * FROM( select vfp.finprod_id finprodId, /*资产代码*/ vfp.finprod_market_id bondid, /*债券代码*/ vfp.finprod_abbr finprodAbbr, /*债券简称*/ vfp.finprod_name finprodName, /*债券名称*/ vfp.issue_price price, /*发行价格*/ (vfp.issue_amt)/100000000 sumprice, /*发行总额*/ vfp.ccy ccy, /*币种*/ fpt.type_1 bondtype, /*债券分类*/ fpt.type_1 bondtypeCode, vfp.bln_area blnArea, /*境内外*/ vfp.trade_market tradingplace, /*交易场所*/ mci.CALENDAR_ID tradingtime, /*交易日历*/ vfp.Issuer issuer, /*发行人*/ DATE_FORMAT(vfp.vdate,'%Y-%m-%d') vdate1, /*起息日*/ DATE_FORMAT(vfp.mdate,'%Y-%m-%d') mdate1, /*到期日*/ vfp.is_sus isSus, /*永续*/ vfp.is_right isRight, /*是否含权债*/ vfp.exe_date exeDate , /*含权债摊销日设置*/ vfp.MATE_PRICE dqshj, /*到期赎回价*/ vfp.coupon_species couponType, /*息票品种*/ vfp.coupon_species couponTypeCode, vccr.basis basis, /*计息基础*/ vccr.calc_type ratetype, /*利率类型*/ (vccr.yield)*100 ratestr, /*初始利率*/
vcpr.END_TDAY_RULE endTdayRule, /*截止日营业日准则*/ vcpr.PAY_TDAY_RULE payTdayRule, /*支付日营业日准则*/ vcpr.pay_cycle paycycle, /*付息频率*/ vcpr.calc_rule calcrule, /*推算方式*/ CASE vcpr.calc_rule WHEN '03' THEN DATE_FORMAT(vcpr.first_pay_date,'%Y-%m-%d') ELSE '' END fpayDate fpayDate /*首次付息日*/ from FIN_PRODUCT vfp left join FIN_CASH_INFO fci on vfp.finprod_id = fci.finprod_id left join ( SSELECT @rownum:=@rownum+1 rownum, R.CASH_ID, R.FINPROD_ID, R.FINPROD_TYPE, R.EFF_DATE, R.BASIS, R.CALC_TYPE, R.YIELD, IF( @CASH_ID = R.CASH_ID, @rank := @rank + 1, @rank := 1 ) AS newResult, @CASH_ID := R.CASH_ID FROM ( SELECT * FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE ORDER BY CASH_ID, EFF_DATE ) R, ( SELECT @rownum := 0, @CASH_ID := NULL, @rank := 0 )b ) vccr on fci.CASH_ID = vccr.CASH_ID AND vccr.newResult =1 left join FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE vcpr on fci.cash_id = vcpr.cash_id left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on vfp.finprod_id = fpt.finprod_id left join MST_CALENDAR_INFO mci on mci.CALENDAR_ID = vfp.CALENDAR_ID where 1 = 1 and vfp.finprod_type = 'F01' and fci.cash_type_1 = '02' AND vfp.finprod_id = #{finprodId} ORDER BY vcpr.Eff_Date desc ) de limit 1

select fep.exercise_status xqstate, /*行权状态*/ DATE_FORMAT(fep.vdate,'%Y-%m-%d') applydatestr, /*行权申请开始日*/ DATE_FORMAT(fep.mdate,'%Y-%m-%d') applydateend, /*行权申请结束日*/ CASE fep.exercise_type WHEN '01' THEN '赎回' WHEN '02' THEN '回售'END xqmode, /*行权方式*/ DATE_FORMAT(fep.EXERCISE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') exerciseDate, /*行权日*/ fep.exercise_price xqnetprice, /*行权净价*/ fep.exercise_remark xqclause /*行权条款*/ from fin_exercise_plan fep left join fin_product fp on fep.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id where fp.finprod_id =#{finprodId}
select DATE_FORMAT(fccr.eff_date,'%Y-%m-%d') efdate, (fccr.yield)*100 rate2 from fin_cash_calc_rule fccr left join fin_product fp on fccr.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id where fp.finprod_id = #{finprodId}

select DATE_FORMAT(fcp.vdate_term,'%Y-%m-%d') theorydatestr, /*理论开始日*/ DATE_FORMAT(fcp.mdate_term,'%Y-%m-%d') theorydateend, /*理论结束日*/ DATE_FORMAT(fcp.vdate,'%Y-%m-%d') actdatestr, /*实际计息开始日*/ DATE_FORMAT(fcp.mdate,'%Y-%m-%d') actdateend, /*实际计息结束日*/ DATE_FORMAT(fcp.pay_date,'%Y-%m-%d') plandate, /*计划支付日*/ fcp.INT_AMT planintamt /*计划支付利息*/ from FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp left join FIN_CASH_INFO fci on fcp.cash_id = fci.cash_id left join fin_product fp on fcp.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id where fp.finprod_id = #{finprodId} and fci.cash_type_1 = '02' order by theorydatestr

select fp.vdate vdate1, DATE_FORMAT(fcp.mdate,'%Y-%m-%d') jsdateend, /*计息截止日*/ DATE_FORMAT(fcp.pay_date,'%Y-%m-%d') paydate, /*支付日*/ /*(fcp.prin_amt)/100 remoney*/ /*还本面额/百元*/ fcp.prin_amt remoney /*还本面额/百元*/ from FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp left join FIN_CASH_INFO fci on fcp.cash_id = fci.cash_id left join fin_product fp on fcp.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id where fp.finprod_id = #{finprodId} and fci.cash_type_1 = '01' order by jsdateend

select DATE_FORMAT(fcp.vdate,'%Y-%m-%d') jsdatestr, /*计息开始日*/ DATE_FORMAT(fcp.mdate,'%Y-%m-%d') jsdateend, /*计息截止日*/ DATE_FORMAT(fcp.pay_date,'%Y-%m-%d') paydate, /*支付日*/ CAST('' AS CHAR )*100 qjrate, /*区间利率*/ /*(fcp.prin_amt)/100 remoney,*/ fcp.prin_amt remoney, /*还本面额/百元*/ fcp.int_prin_amt jxamt, /*计息本金*/ (fcp.int_amt) yjint, /*应计利息/百元*/ fcp.cash_amt cashflow /*现金流*/ from fin_cash_plan fcp left join fin_product fp on fcp.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id where fp.finprod_id=#{finprodId} order by jsdatestr

COUPON_SPECIES = #{couponType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATE_USER = #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE finprod_id = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
